messages_body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier - it was great to meet you and the team. Quick recap from our discovery call so we have alignment and clear next steps.

Summary of needs / pain points you shared:
- SOC 2 Type II evidence and timeline for Redwood onboarding (pre-contract).
- Audit logs retention and access controls for customer events (7+ years requirement noted).
- Data retention & deletion policy for PII and inferred data.
- DPA language around subprocessors and data residency (US-East preferred).
- Pen test evidence / third-party security assessments for vendor review.

What we told you we can do today:
- Provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report and a security overview pack (attached).
- Share our audit-logging architecture and retention options (we support configurable retention windows and can provide export access).
- Surface DPA standard terms and discuss any redlines with Legal.
- Provide pen test summaries and contact for full reports under NDA.

Immediate next steps (owner / timing):
1) I will send the SOC 2 report, security overview, and a short retention policy summary by EOD (owner: Rishi) - ACTION: sent attachments.
2) You to confirm the retention window you require (e.g., 7 years for audit logs) and if any logs must be stored in-region (owner: Jordan) - please reply.
3) Schedule a follow-up call with your security team and our security lead (Marissa) - propose Wed/Thu next week (owner: Jordan + Rishi).
4) Procurement to share preferred contracting timeline and any required PO process (owner: Procurement).

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf, SOC2-Type2-Report-Redwood.pdf, Retention_Policy_Summary.docx

If I missed anything urgent from the call, flag it and I will update. Looking forward to the next steps - happy to loop in Legal/Security as needed.

Cheers,
Rishi
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0132

Hi Jordan - thanks, answers inline below.

1) Retention: We support configurable retention windows for audit logs. Out of the box we have 90/365/1095-day presets; for enterprise customers we support extended retention up to 7 years. For the 7-year retention use case we typically deploy a cold-storage export strategy with scheduled snapshots and WORM-style access controls; we can provide the export process and schema for ingestion into your archival system.

2) Residency: Yes - we can pin log storage to US-East (Virginia) for dedicated/private deployments. For our hosted offering we maintain region-specific storage and can meet US-East residency requirements for Acme under a contractual data-residency addendum.

3) Pen tests: We can share a redacted pen test report and summary today; full reports are available under NDA. I've uploaded the redacted summary and SOC 2 report to the drive folder linked below.

Next steps (updated):
- I uploaded the security pack and SOC 2 redacted report: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5Eredwood-acme-compliance
- Confirmed we can support 7-year retention via a cold-export approach - we will document the export process for your auditors (owner: Redwood Security/Compliance).
- We can pin storage to US-East and will include residency language in the DPA addendum (owner: Legal).
- Schedule follow-up security call Thu Apr 15 10am ET (we're tentatively booked - Marissa will join).

I'll also loop in Marissa from our security team to handle pen test evidence and provide more detail on the export/retention mechanics.

Thanks,
Rishi

Hi team - thanks for the details, Jordan.

We're ready to proceed with the evidence handoff and have the following ready:
- Redacted pen test summary (attached in the shared drive).
- Evidence runbook: we produce daily audit-log exports in newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) with a signed manifest; for long-term retention we store snapshots in an immutable S3 bucket and can provide hash-signed manifests for verification.
- Typical verification artifacts: manifest hashes, export timestamps, S3 object URIs (we can provide a search snapshot for the auditors).

Cost note: cold snapshot export and long-term S3 storage is usually billed as a separate archival line item. Rough estimate: ~$1,200/month for the 7-year retention profile for the expected event volume you described - we'll refine after we finalize event rates.

I'll attach the pen test redacted summary to the drive folder and will send the NDA template if you want full report access. Planning to join Thu Apr 15 10am ET.

Marissa
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
marissa@redwoodinference.com
